settings.heading: Meal prep in Crawfordsville
settings.text: Chef-made meals from a local kitchen, on a short menu that changes every week. Order by Thursday at 6 PM, pick up or get delivery on Tuesday.

settings.title: Pick your meals
settings.text: A new menu goes up every week. Choose your meals and your base, then check out online.

settings.title: We cook it fresh
settings.text: Chef-prepared with fresh, never-frozen ingredients, one meal to a container.

settings.title: Pickup or delivery
settings.text: Grab your order from the cooler at Ironsmith's Gym, or have it brought to your door.

settings.title: Heat and eat
settings.text: Two to three minutes in the microwave for a big, high-protein meal.

settings.heading: Order by Thursday. Eat well all week.

settings.title: Pickup at Ironsmith's Gym
settings.text: Our pickup cooler. Collect your order there on Tuesday.

settings.title: Delivered to your door
settings.text: Local delivery on Tuesday. The delivery options for your address, and any fee, show at checkout.

settings.quote: Ordering is simple and straightforward, and they have both pickup or delivery options. The food is always fresh and as advertised.
settings.author: Adam Welcher

settings.quote: Each meal is filling with a good serving size and has great flavor. Definitely recommend giving them a try!
settings.author: Tamara Peck

settings.quote: We use Casa Fresca for work lunch events and home personal meals. So good!
settings.author: Justin Riggins

settings.quote: Casa Fresca has completely simplified mealtime for our family!
settings.author: Brittani Cohee

settings.quote: It makes meal prep for my diet soooooo much easier. Thank you!
settings.author: Adriana Smith

settings.quote: The meals taste amazing and are healthy. They are great if you are on the go or just don’t want to cook.
settings.author: Ethan Chester
